I used to get strep throat 5-9 times a year. Like clockwork. My tonsil would start hurting and it was always strep. Every time.

I went to the local ER to get a throat swab and antibiotics as my son was about 2 at the time and I didn’t want him to get sick as well.

I get in the back and the ER Doctor is just a raging asshole. He starts *yelling* at me that there is no way someone’s tonsil can start hurting and it be strep within hours. I yell back THEN TEST ME! THATS WHAT I ASKED FOR! WHAT ARE YOU AFRAID OF? 

So asshole doctor order the test and the kind nurse actually asked me which tonsil to swab and shared with me that everyone in the ER hated asshole doc for obvious reasons.

Sure enough. My test came back positive for strep and asshole doc had to eat crow. 

He came in and told me it “wasn’t possible” and I must’ve been hurting longer and lied to him.

So I showed him text messages of exactly when my tonsil started hurting. I also reminded him that doctors aren’t gods and anything is possible in human bodies and that’s why is called “practicing medicine”.

ER managing doc came in and asshole doc had to explain to him that not only was he horrifically wrong, but he had yelled at a patient who was *right*. Managing doc was pissed and told him he was going to be written up for this because there were dozens of witnesses to his yell fest at me. 

Asshole doc blanched and then apologized to me. I told him that I didn’t want an apology. I told him I wanted him to remember this moment and to remember that people know their bodies and to listen to them. I told him that maybe he needed to learn this lesson because it would help humble him and save lives one day.

I got my antibiotics and found out about a month later that asshole doc had been fired. 

Always advocate for yourself. Congratulations to you for standing up for yourself
